criteria.requirement: Extend update_in with keyword-only create=True. With create=False, update only fully existing paths; if any key is absent, return a shallow root copy without calling func or creating branches. Existing None counts as present. Preserve input data and untouched branch identities, one-shot paths, factory types, curried exports, callback exceptions and default upsert behavior. Reject an empty only-update path with ValueError and invalid create types with TypeError.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
